{"action":"done","summary":"Constitution phase complete. Artifact: /testbed/.specify/memory/constitution.md (110 lines, verified via head/grep/wc: title 'cachetools Constitution', Sync Impact Report HTML comment, 5 principles, no leftover bracket tokens, footer 'Version 1.0.0 | Ratified 2026-10-17 | Last Amended 2026-10-17').

Version 1.0.0 (initial ratification): the prior file was an unfilled template, so all 5 approved principles were newly added: I. Preserve Existing Public API Behavior; II. Testable Acceptance Criteria; III. Evidence Over Assertion; IV. Simple Scoped Implementations; V. Documented Assumptions and Regressions. Added sections: Scope and Deferred Intents (defers TaggedCache R01-R03 and the Claim-A put-recency variant put_no_recency_refresh, 2026-09-21, to later phases; upstream tests unchanged, project-owned tests/notes allowed) and Development Workflow (phase artifacts, evidence-citing summaries, convergence reruns acceptance_public.py). Governance covers amendment procedure, semver policy, and per-phase compliance review. Project name 'cachetools' chosen from the task. No TODO placeholders deferred.

Checks: resolve_template.py constitution-template --json succeeded (core template fallback, no venv); .specify/extensions.yml absent, so no before/after hooks were run (verified before and after the write). No application source, tests, or template files were modified — only the constitution file.

Suggested commit message: docs: ratify cachetools constitution v1.0.0 (five principles + governance).

Next Actions (deferred non-governance intents, not invoked): (1) TaggedCache feature R01-R03 and Claim-A extension -> $speckit-specify using SPECIFY_FEATURE_DIRECTORY=/testbed/specs/001-transactions; (2) after specify/plan -> $speckit-plan and $speckit-implement, with convergence rerunning acceptance_public.py and project tests."}
